name: 01604 · Worcester, MA
findings: ZIP 01604 (Worcester) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01604 (Worcester) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01604 (Worcester) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 65 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
